phase.title: Onboard the frontend and audit its lockfile

summary:
Completed Phase 8. Added `renovate.json` with weekly lockfile maintenance and React/Vitest grouping; added weekly/manual `.github/workflows/dependency-audit.yml` with separate full and production JSON reports, seven-day artifacts, non-gating findings, and strict operational-error handling; added `docs/dependency-automation.md` plus README, documentation-index, and AGENTS guidance.

Validation passed for Node 24/npm prerequisites, `npm ci`, Prettier, strict Renovate schema validation, actionlint, workflow success/error classification, documentation paths, and `git diff --check`. Renovate extracted 65 occurrences: 44 npm, five Dockerfile, and 16 GitHub Actions dependencies. Both audits reproduced the benchmark: full 20 findings and production-only four high findings. `package.json` and `package-lock.json` hashes remain unchanged.

GitHub Actions/setup-node lookups remain pending Phase 12 authentication. Renovate’s local Docker Hub client repeatedly returned `ERR_SOCKET_CLOSED_BEFORE_CONNECTION` and `no-result` for Node and NGINX despite successful direct anonymous endpoint checks; this non-authentication limitation is documented and requires successful hosted lookup before activation. No package upgrades, lockfile refresh, frontend code, or later-phase work was performed. Durable handoff: `docs/dependency-automation.md`.
